d: Worker noticed the guardrail on the elevated walkway near the rolling area is missing. Risk of fall from approximately 2 meters height.
Oil leak found near the furnace. Hot surface nearby — risk of ignition and fire in the production area during operation.
Maintenance technician was performing cleaning inside the conveyor system when it started unexpectedly. No injuries but a very serious near miss.
During morning inspection, workers observed operating in the production area without safety helmets in a mandatory hard hat zone.
Three operators have reported recurring back pain from repeatedly lifting heavy steel coils manually at the packing station.
